schemaFaqHome.a1: Social Forex is a web platform with live forex-related quotes, an economic calendar, trading calculators, structured academy lessons, a forum, and optional trading signals. Everything is educational and informational, not personalized investment advice.
schemaFaqHome.q2: Do I need an account to use it?
schemaFaqHome.a2: You can browse many tools and pages such as live quotes, the economic calendar, and academy content without signing in. Some features like posting in the forum, signals, or private messages require registration.
schemaFaqHome.q3: Where should a complete beginner start?
schemaFaqHome.a3: Open Start here for a practical path: Exness registration, MetaTrader 5, a demo account, login, then a small XAUUSD practice trade on demo. Use the Academy for theory such as risk and spreads.
schemaFaqHome.q4: Are prices and calendar data guaranteed accurate?
schemaFaqHome.a4: No. Quotes and calendar entries depend on third-party data feeds and can be delayed, incomplete, or temporarily unavailable. Always confirm critical times and prices on your broker platform or official sources.
schemaFaqHome.a5: No. Forex and CFD trading carry a high risk of loss, including your full balance. Content on the site does not consider your personal situation; consult a licensed professional when needed.

start.metaDescription: Register Exness, install MT5, open a demo account, log in, then practice buying XAUUSD 0.01. Educational only — not investment advice.
start.affiliateNotice: The Exness registration link below is an affiliate link: we may earn a commission when you sign up, at no extra cost to you.
start.title: Start here — Exness & MetaTrader 5 (demo)
start.subtitle: A practical path for beginners: register with Exness, install MT5, create a demo account, log in, then place a tiny gold (XAUUSD) buy on demo.
start.intro: Educational only. Not investment advice. Trading can result in total loss. Demo uses virtual money. Live trading differs. If your broker screens differ, follow Exness and MetaQuotes official documentation.
start.brokerStep1_body: Use the button below to open the Exness registration page (affiliate). Complete email verification and any identity checks requested. You need an Exness account before you can create a MetaTrader login and demo credentials.
start.brokerStep2_body: Desktop: download MetaTrader 5 from the official MetaQuotes site and install it. Mobile: install the app named "MetaTrader 5" from the App Store or Google Play. You will log in with the Exness credentials from your Exness account (steps 3–4), not a separate MetaQuotes-only account.
start.brokerStep3_body: Log in to Exness Personal Area (web or Exness app). Go to Accounts → New account → choose Demo → MetaTrader 5. Note the server name (e.g. Exness-MT5Trial or similar) and your demo login and password. Keep them private.
start.brokerStep4_title: 4. Log in to MetaTrader 5 with demo
start.brokerStep4_body: Open MetaTrader 5. Use File → Login to Trade Account, or enter details on the first screen. Server: paste or select the exact Exness demo server name from your Exness email. Login and password: from step 3. Press Login — you should see balance in demo currency in the Terminal.
start.brokerStep5_body: Open Market Watch (Ctrl+M on desktop). If XAUUSD is missing: right-click Market Watch → Symbols → Metals → add XAUUSD and show. Double-click XAUUSD (or New Order). Set Volume to 0.01 lots. Confirm order type is market execution. Click Buy. The position appears under Terminal → Trade. Close when you want — practice only; no profit goal.
start.brokerStep5_ctaQuotes: View XAUUSD on Social Forex quotes
start.closingHint: For theory (risk, spreads, news), continue with the Academy after you have tried this practice flow. You can compare gold prices on our quotes page.
start.aiAssistantIntro: Paste the text below into your assistant so it knows you are following the Exness + MT5 demo path on this site.

schemaFaq.q1: What is this Start page for?
schemaFaq.a1: It is a hands-on path: register Exness, install MT5, open a demo account, log in, then practice a small buy on XAUUSD. Theory is in the Academy.
schemaFaq.a2: No. Social Forex does not provide investment advice. Broker screens and product names may change; follow Exness and MetaQuotes official documentation.
schemaFaq.q3: Why is there an affiliate link?
schemaFaq.a3: The Exness registration link may earn us a commission. It does not change your price. You do not have to use Exness to trade — this is one supported path for beginners.
schemaFaq.q4: Is MT5 the same as Exness?
schemaFaq.a4: MT5 is MetaQuotes software. Exness is your broker. You log in to MT5 with the Exness demo credentials and server your broker gives you.
